- Initial release of automation-token-optimizer.
- Automatically audits monthly token consumption of all scheduled tasks.
- Identifies top high-consumption tasks and analyzes their prompts for optimization.
- Provides actionable suggestions: script conversion, frequency reduction, prompt simplification, or task splitting.
- Generates a comprehensive, ready-to-use monthly audit report with detailed optimization recommendations.
